counters.name: guardrails-commit-guard-spawns
counters.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=plugins/guardrails bash plugins/performance/scripts/spawn-census.sh --shim-dir "$HOME/.cache/performance-ratchet/shim" --label guardrails-commit-guard --no-ledger --tool awk --tool git --tool jq --tool sed --tool grep --tool dirname --stdin '{"tool_name":"Bash","cwd":".","tool_input":{"command":"git commit -m \"feat: add x\""}}' -- node plugins/guardrails/hooks/exec-bash.mjs plugins/guardrails/hooks/run-guards.sh --lib lib/powershell/ps-command.sh --max-substitutions 256 --max-command-len 16384 block-no-verify.sh block-dangerous-git.sh flag-commit-pr-skill-bypass.sh block-noncanonical-commit.sh block-convention-violation.sh block-windows-drive-tmp.sh block-exported-msys-pathconv.sh block-root-delete-target.sh | grep -F ' rc=0 '
counters.goal: The Bash PreToolUse guard row spends at most this many external processes judging a git commit with no convention cache (plugins/guardrails/hooks/hooks.json, block-convention-violation.sh). Correlation: unproven: not measured

counters.name: harness-ops-stop-hook-failure-audit-growth
counters.command: bash scripts/hook-census.sh harness-ops Stop hook-failure-audit.sh '{"session_id":"census","transcript_path":"@TRANSCRIPT@","hook_event_name":"Stop","cwd":"@DIR@"}' --seed --measure growth
counters.goal: A warm Stop reads the same transcript bytes at 10 MiB as at 50 KiB: the cursor read follows what the turn appended, not the session's length (#4408). Measured on ubuntu-24.04 with bash 5.2.21, git 2.55.0, jq 1.7, strace 6.8; the ratchet step prints the current versions. Correlation: unproven: not measured

counters.name: disk-hygiene-stop-guard-launch-monitor-growth
counters.command: bash scripts/hook-census.sh disk-hygiene Stop guard_launch_monitor.py '{"session_id":"census","transcript_path":"@TRANSCRIPT@","hook_event_name":"Stop","cwd":"@DIR@"}' --seed --measure growth --setup 'mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/guard-launch-monitor" && : >"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/guard-launch-monitor/census.launched"'
counters.goal: With a guard launch marked, a warm Stop's monitor reads the same transcript bytes at 10 MiB as at 50 KiB (guard_launch_monitor.py incremental read, #4422). Measured on ubuntu-24.04 with bash 5.2.21, python3 3.14.7, strace 6.8; the ratchet step prints the current versions. Correlation: unproven: not measured

counters.name: typos-format-stop-end-of-turn-option-off-spawns
counters.goal: With typos_format_end_of_turn at its default (false), the Stop row costs only the node launcher: the --require-true gate closes before bash starts. Stop fires on every turn end, so this is what every turn costs a user who never opted in. Measured 1 on WSL2 Ubuntu with bash 5.3.9, dash as sh, strace 6.19; the ratchet step prints the current versions. Correlation: unproven: not measured

counters.name: multi-agent-pretooluse-bash-docs-fetcher-gate-spawns
counters.goal: A Bash call outside a multi-agent:docs-fetcher subagent costs only node, which reads the payload, finds another agent_type and stays quiet; the row has no if, so this is what every Bash call costs. Not yet measured with this row: the ceiling is the node-launcher count (1), and the first CI run corrects it with propose-tighten. Correlation: unproven: not measured

counters.name: js-complexity-share
counters.goal: Production JavaScript functions (.js .jsx .mjs .cjs, scoped by scripts/js-complexity-share.py: test files, vendored files and sanctioned copies out) at cyclomatic complexity 20 or above, the code-metrics reference (ISO/IEC 5055:2021 section 8.2.117), stay at most this percent of the functions measured. A no-worse ratchet, not a target. Measured 2.54 (52 of 2046) at 7787be41e with lizard 1.24.0, pinned in .github/requirements-ci.txt; the counter prints its lizard version. Correlation: unproven: a code-shape share, not a runtime cost
